Q5217.reason: The confirmation is expressly conditional on the new loading charge, so under UCC 2-207 it is a counteroffer that was never accepted; a material price add-on also would not enter automatically.

Q8260.reason: Water is the direct product of O2 at the end of the chain and stops at once, while glycolysis still makes pyruvate and some ATP.

Q5585.reason: The question is leading on direct of the calling party’s own non-adverse witness, so the objection should be sustained; judicial notice and lay-speed foundation do not cure the form.
